# The frozen list of the routes /api/v1 alone serves: every row of v1Rows (routes_table.go), one
# `METHOD path` a line, sorted by path then method as testdata/routes.txt is. Each names its
# /api/v2 route in its Successor; every route added after /api/v2 began is served in both
# versions by one declaration (a routeRow), so TestAV1OnlyRowOutsideTheFrozenListFails refuses a
# row /api/v1 alone serves that this list does not hold, and a line no row of v1Rows is.
#
# It holds the 184 rows of c8a44f97's testdata/routes.txt that are no rows of the INFRA-979 tree
# (v2Infra979Rows: those five are served in both versions), and each row another pull request
# merged into main before /api/v2's change merged. Such a row is added here at the forward merge
# that brings it, with its successor and its route-map entry in the same commit, and ends in a
# ` # ` note naming that pull request: it is outside the bound of 137 /api/v2 routes for the rows
# of c8a44f97 (TestEveryV1RowNamesItsV2Route).
